case.message: Did Tesla stay within its stated 2023 and 2024 capital-spending outlook? Give the quoted ranges, actual cash PP&E spending, and compare revenue and net income with GM and Ford.

# Tesla 2023-2024 Capital Spending and Peer Comparison

**Contradicted**

TSLA revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $97.690 billion [E06fb99d6f5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html), up from $96.773 billion for 2023-12-31 [E11b4f42020](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html). TSLA net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $7.091 billion [E882dff63b5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html), down from $14.997 billion for 2023-12-31 [E67dab066ab](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html). TSLA cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $11.339 billion [Efe9447dc7f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html), up from $8.898 billion for 2023-12-31 [Ec516a365d5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html). The retrieved outlook gave a capital-spending range of $6.000 billion to $8.000 billion for the year ending 2023-12-31 [E730dbabced](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017023001409/tsla-20221231.htm). Reported cash PP&E purchases were $8.898 billion, above quoted range [Ec516a365d5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html). The retrieved outlook gave a capital-spending range of $7.000 billion to $9.000 billion for the year ending 2024-12-31 [E730dbabced](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017023001409/tsla-20221231.htm). Reported cash PP&E purchases were $11.339 billion, above quoted range [Efe9447dc7f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of January 31, 2023, Tesla stated in its 2022 Form 10-K that it expected capital expenditures to support its projects globally to be between $6.00 and $8.00 billion in 2023 and between $7.00 and $9.00 billion in each of the following two fiscal years [E730dbabced](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017023001409/tsla-20221231.htm). Prior quarterly disclosures in 2022 similarly projected capital expenditures between $6.00 and $8.00 billion for 2022 and each of the next two fiscal years [E580785fd2f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017022019867/tsla-20220930.htm) [E48a453ba97](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017022019867/tsla-20220930.htm) [E8a066b5484](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017022012936/tsla-20220630.htm) [Eb5627adbf5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017022012936/tsla-20220630.htm). Historical annual capital expenditures for Tesla were $3,157,000,000 in 2020, $6,482,000,000 in 2021, and $7,158,000,000 in 2022 [E66cc3a0d7f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000156459021004599/0001564590-21-004599-index.html) [E368dbf8349](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017022000796/0000950170-22-000796-index.html) [E47389143dc](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017023001409/0000950170-23-001409-index.html).

## What happened later

For the fiscal year ending December 31, 2023, Tesla reported actual cash payments for property, plant, and equipment of $8,898,000,000, which was above the quoted range of $6.00 to $8.00 billion [Ec516a365d5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html). For the fiscal year ending December 31, 2024, Tesla reported actual cash payments for property, plant, and equipment of $11,339,000,000, which was above the quoted range of $7.00 to $9.00 billion [Efe9447dc7f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html). Tesla's revenue for these periods was $96,773,000,000 in 2023 and $97,690,000,000 in 2024, while net income was $14,997,000,000 in 2023 and $7,091,000,000 in 2024 [E11b4f42020](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html) [E06fb99d6f5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html) [E67dab066ab](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html) [E882dff63b5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html).

## The peer test

General Motors (fiscal year ending 2023-12-31) reported revenue of $171,842,000,000, net income of $10,127,000,000, and capex of $10,970,000,000 [E05a1eabc58](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785824000031/0001467858-24-000031-index.html) [Eb2e7c6d470](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785824000031/0001467858-24-000031-index.html) [Ee1d2d02037](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785824000031/0001467858-24-000031-index.html). For the fiscal year ending 2024-12-31, GM reported revenue of $187,442,000,000, net income of $6,008,000,000, and capex of $10,830,000,000 [E16ec1705e6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785825000032/0001467858-25-000032-index.html) [E1352fe29f3](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785825000032/0001467858-25-000032-index.html) [E14895b8097](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785825000032/0001467858-25-000032-index.html). Ford (fiscal year ending 2023-12-31) reported revenue of $176,191,000,000 and net income of $4,347,000,000 [E72a491f2a6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/37996/000003799624000009/0000037996-24-000009-index.html) [E90b162746e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/37996/000003799624000009/0000037996-24-000009-index.html). For the fiscal year ending 2024-12-31, Ford reported revenue of $184,992,000,000 and net income of $5,879,000,000 [E7a1d3a94d0](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/37996/000003799625000013/0000037996-25-000013-index.html) [Ebebae703eb](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/37996/000003799625000013/0000037996-25-000013-index.html). Ford capex data is missing due to unsupported XBRL tags in the provided tool window [E4c3284306d] [E2ce635043b].

## Cross-examination

Management's statements regarding expected capital expenditures represent forward-looking outlook passages rather than unconditional guarantees [E730dbabced](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017023001409/tsla-20221231.htm) [E309c4ed784](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017023001409/tsla-20221231.htm). When compared against quantitative range checks, Tesla's actual cash PP&E outlays of $8,898,000,000 in 2023 and $11,339,000,000 in 2024 exceeded the upper bounds of their respective guidance ranges [Ec516a365d5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html) [Efe9447dc7f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html). Revenue growth and positive operating cash flows cannot be used to verify spending targets or forecast bounds, as financial results do not prove management intent or causation [Eb3b11f8745](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html) [Ea345f0bc68](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html).

## Limits

- Ford annual capex data is missing due to unsupported XBRL tags in the provided tool window.
- Macroeconomic data series are classified under hindsight context rather than known_then.

sections.title: What was knowable then
sections.text: As of January 31, 2023, Tesla stated in its 2022 Form 10-K that it expected capital expenditures to support its projects globally to be between $6.00 and $8.00 billion in 2023 and between $7.00 and $9.00 billion in each of the following two fiscal years [E730dbabced]. Prior quarterly disclosures in 2022 similarly projected capital expenditures between $6.00 and $8.00 billion for 2022 and each of the next two fiscal years [E580785fd2f] [E48a453ba97] [E8a066b5484] [Eb5627adbf5]. Historical annual capital expenditures for Tesla were $3,157,000,000 in 2020, $6,482,000,000 in 2021, and $7,158,000,000 in 2022 [E66cc3a0d7f] [E368dbf8349] [E47389143dc].

sections.title: What happened later
sections.text: For the fiscal year ending December 31, 2023, Tesla reported actual cash payments for property, plant, and equipment of $8,898,000,000, which was above the quoted range of $6.00 to $8.00 billion [Ec516a365d5]. For the fiscal year ending December 31, 2024, Tesla reported actual cash payments for property, plant, and equipment of $11,339,000,000, which was above the quoted range of $7.00 to $9.00 billion [Efe9447dc7f]. Tesla's revenue for these periods was $96,773,000,000 in 2023 and $97,690,000,000 in 2024, while net income was $14,997,000,000 in 2023 and $7,091,000,000 in 2024 [E11b4f42020] [E06fb99d6f5] [E67dab066ab] [E882dff63b5].
